subject: RFI: Support & operational readiness questionnaire
messages:
From: James Ellis <james.ellis@acfordbank.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Lydia Chan <lydia.chan@acfordbank.com>, procurement@acfordbank.com
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: Support & operational readiness questions

Diego,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of our procurement RFI for vendor operational readiness, can you please provide clarifications on the items below? We'd like a short written response and a follow-up 30-min walkthrough next week.

1) TAM coverage: typical FTE allocation per account size; local time-zone coverage for on-call; escalation handoffs between TAM and 24x7 NOC.
2) Incident severity definitions (P0/P1/P2) and response/ack SLA targets for each (ack, mitigation, remediation).
3) On-call contact methods and escalation matrix (PagerDuty, phone, email) and whether we get a direct escalation contact for P0s.
4) Customer-facing incident comms cadence and templates (initial notice, status updates, resolution summary).
5) Post-incident review (timeline, who attends, artifacts delivered).
6) Integration options for our observability (S3/Kinesis logs, PagerDuty, ServiceNow), and access to audit logs for regulated audits.
7) Any geographic limitations for support (e.g., vendor cannot provide on-call in APAC).
8) Attach SOC2 or other evidence and the most recent penetration test summary (or a link).

Appreciate a response by EOD Wednesday (2027-04-14) so we can include it in our vendor evaluation pack.

Best,
James
James Ellis
Dir., Vendor Management
Acford Bank

Subject: Re: RFI: Support & operational readiness questions — draft response attached

Diego / team — attached is a consolidated draft (Operational_Readiness_Response_v1.docx). Key highlights below; please review and flag any edits by EOD today. I will add the SOC2/pen-test links that Karthik provides and finalize the TAM schedule PDF.

Summary (for client):
- TAM coverage: Assigned Senior TAM + 2 primary rotation engineers. 0700–1900 local coverage M-F for the named TAM; 24x7 NOC monitors and will escalate to TAM for P1/P0s. TAM provides weekly office hours and monthly business reviews.
- Escalation matrix & channels: PagerDuty primary for P0/P1 (phone escalation enabled), email for P2/P3, and a named P0 escalation contact (escalation bridge number) available for critical incidents.
- Severity & SLA targets: P0 (service impacting) — ack within 15 minutes, mitigation/partial workaround within 60 minutes, full remediation roadmap within 72 hours. P1 — ack 60 minutes, mitigation within 8 hours. P2/P3 documented in attachment.
- Incident comms cadence: Initial acknowledge within SLA with a short summary; status updates every 30–60 minutes for P0s until mitigated; final RCA delivered within 5 business days with timeline and corrective actions.
- Post-incident: 2-week timeline for root-cause analysis draft; a 60-minute PIR meeting including TAM, engineering owner, customer SRE (if desired), and success manager. Artifacts: timeline, logs, impact estimate, remediation plan.
- Integrations & audit access: Native PagerDuty & ServiceNow integration; secure S3 export for audit logs; API access to activity/audit logs (read-only) under contractual controls; we provide an SOC2 Type II report and a summary of the most recent pen test (redacted).
- Geographic coverage: Full commercial support for US and EU regions. APAC coverage available with customer subscription to dedicated TAM (limited when using on-prem private deployments).

Attachments included: Operational_Readiness_Response_v1.docx (draft), Redwood_TAM_Coverage_Schedule.pdf (skeleton), redwood-soc2-type2-link.txt (link stub).

Please confirm and I will export to PDF and send to Acford.

— Marissa
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

James — thanks for the list. Attached is our consolidated response (Redwood_Support_Readiness_AcfordBank.pdf) which includes the TAM schedule and SOC2/pen-test references. Highlights:

- Named TAM coverage: Senior TAM assigned to the account with 0700–1900 local coverage; TAM rotation and on-call handoff notes attached.
- Escalation & SLOs: P0 ack 15 min, mitigation plan within 60 min, final remediation roadmap within 72 hours; PagerDuty is primary escalation channel; direct escalation bridge available for P0s.
- Incident comms: We will provide an initial notification within SLA and status updates every 30–60 minutes for P0s; RCA within 5 business days and a PIR meeting scheduled within 10 business days.
- Integrations & audit: We support PagerDuty, ServiceNow, secure S3 exports, and API access to audit logs (read-only). SOC2 Type II report and a redacted pen-test summary are included via secured links.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call to walk through — slots available Thu 4/15 09:00–10:30 PT or 14:00–16:00 PT. Please let me know which works and we'll send a calendar invite.

2) Can we get read-only access to the DAMS logs (our internal audit asks for this) or is S3 export the only supported method?

We can do Thu 4/15 at 09:30 PT for the walkthrough. If you can confirm the TAM participation for P0s and the DAMS access model in the call, that will cover what the procurement team needs.

2) DAMS logs: We can provide read-only API access to activity/audit logs under an MSA addendum; S3 export is available as an alternative. We'll cover the technical details in the walkthrough.
